items.prompt: Which scalar state is sufficient for this one-pass recurrence?

options.text: Only the last value, discarding previous highs.
options.why: A drawdown can be measured from a much earlier peak.

options.text: Only the global minimum seen, with no peak denominator.
options.why: The best earlier peak is also needed at each current day.

options.text: A sorted copy of all prices, ignoring their dates.
options.why: Sorting destroys the temporal order required by drawdown.

options.text: The current prefix peak and the worst drawdown so far.
options.why: Each new value updates the peak and its current decline, then preserves the worst earlier decline.

items.explanation: Each new value updates the peak and its current decline, then preserves the worst earlier decline.
